While test mode is on, Kestrel\'s agent and routines will send and share only to Telegram\'s Saved Messages, WhatsApp\'s Message yourself, Viber\'s My Notes and your own email address, and they will make no calls. Keep it on while you test Kestrel.
Kestrel\'s agent comes later. Until then, test mode changes nothing. The safety mode, agent-free apps and screenshot approvals come with the agent.

Run scripts\\push-models.ps1 -Serial <serial> on your computer. It downloads the speech models once and copies them to this phone, and Kestrel checks them against the hashes that come with the app.

Kestrel reads the screen and acts on it through this service.
Android lists Kestrel\'s accessibility service as on, but the service does not run, for example after Kestrel was stopped. Turn it off and on again.
Kestrel listens for your voice and shows what it is doing in a notification.
So that Android does not stop Kestrel\'s listening in the background.

Kestrel\'s battery use is Restricted, so Android stops its listening in the background. Set it to Unrestricted.
Also add Kestrel to \"Never sleeping apps\" in the battery settings.
Make Kestrel the default digital assistant

Optional: so that the assistant gesture, such as a long press of Home or the side key, starts Kestrel and lets you say a task. Android does not let an app ask for this, so pick Kestrel as the digital assistant app in Default apps.
Let Kestrel answer and decline calls
Optional: while a call rings, Kestrel then listens for \"answer\", \"answer on speaker\" and \"decline\", also on the lock screen. Kestrel reads no phone number and no call log.
Sign in to an AI provider and choose the models
This step comes with Kestrel\'s provider settings.
Optional: so that Voice Access and Kestrel do not react to the same words.
Voice Access and Kestrel are both on, so they may react to the same words.
Kestrel is paused during the call
Kestrel cannot use the screen, the accessibility button or the shortcut until you turn the service on again. If Kestrel is listening, it goes on listening. Tap to open the accessibility settings.
Android did not let Kestrel open its settings from the background. Tap here to open them.
After an unlock, during calls, with earbuds, and the ways to start Kestrel
While Kestrel listens, 30 seconds without speech pause it. \"Kestrel, wake up\" resumes it.

During a call, Kestrel listens for \"Kestrel, hang up\", \"Kestrel, mute\" and \"Kestrel, speaker\" while the phone is unlocked. Say the name first: Kestrel ignores these commands without it, because the other person\'s voice can come through the speaker, and it writes down nothing of the call\'s conversation. If Kestrel does not react, say the command again. The other person hears these commands too. They need Kestrel\'s accessibility service: without it, Android silences Kestrel\'s microphone during a call.
With Bluetooth earbuds connected, Kestrel records with their microphone. The earbuds then switch to their call profile, which makes music sound worse.
Kestrel\'s accessibility service is off, so the shortcut and the button do not start Kestrel.
The accessibility shortcut does not start Kestrel. Choose Kestrel for it in Android\'s accessibility settings.
The accessibility button does not start Kestrel. Choose Kestrel for it in Android\'s accessibility settings.
Kestrel\'s Quick Settings tile starts Kestrel. Android does not tell apps whether you added it, so add it when you edit Quick Settings.
Kestrel is the digital assistant, so the assistant gesture, such as a long press of Home, starts it.
Kestrel is not the digital assistant. Pick it as the digital assistant app in Default apps.
Kokoro\'s files are not on the phone. Copy them with scripts\\push-models.ps1 -Kokoro.
Some of Kokoro\'s files are missing or damaged. Copy them again with scripts\\push-models.ps1 -Kokoro.
Kokoro did not load the last time that Kestrel turned on, so Piper spoke. Kestrel tries Kokoro again the next time it turns on.
Kokoro is too slow on this phone: it needs %1$s seconds to say one second of speech, so Piper speaks instead. Tap Kokoro again, and Kestrel measures it again the next time it turns on.

Require verbs, numbers, and what you can say

With this on, a name alone, such as \"Save\", does nothing, and you say \"tap Save\". With it off, a name alone taps an element when you say its name exactly and no other element has that name, or when the name clearly fits that one element.
